steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the case.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Capture the automatic title before adding product rows.
Add the CYLINDER product as the first row with quantity 10.
Verify the first row contains the requested product.
Verify the first product receives its default variant.
Verify the first row has its own requested quantity.
Set the first product row's delivery location.
Add AAC BLOCKS as a separate second row with quantity 5.
Verify that two product rows are present.
Verify the second row contains AAC BLOCKS.
Verify the second product receives its default variant.
Verify the second row has an independent requested quantity.
Set the second product row's delivery location.
Verify the first row's delivery location.
Verify the second row's delivery location.
Verify that the automatic title changed after product rows were added.
